Greetings, Agents!

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Deadpool and Gwenpool have returned to MARVEL Future Fight with new tricks!​

 

Meet the new Uniforms of Deadpool and Gwenpool, Tier-3 advancement of Gwenpool,
and new Artifacts for the two Super Heroes through this additional patch.

 

Check out the new April Fools’ Day looks of the two Super Heroes
by downloading the 3/29 patch.

 

■ 3/29 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 3/30 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 3/29 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT)
* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances 
and the completion time will be further noticed once the patch has been finished.
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch. 
* When the patch is done, please restart and apply the patch for better service.
​

[3/30 (Wed) 3:48 (UTC+0), 3/29 (Tue) 20:48 (PDT) added]

The patch has been completed as of 3/30 (Wed) 3:44 (UTC+0), 3/29 (Tue) 20:44 (PDT). 

We apologize for the delay with the patch application.

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.


▣ Two New Uniforms
​
New April Fools’ Day Uniforms will be added to the two Super Heroes! 
The two Super Heroes seems to have dressed as each other!
Check out the abilities of the new Uniforms,
Deadpool <April Pools> and Gwenpool <April Pools>.
 

 

 
▣ Gwenpool Tier-3
​
Gwenpool is now available for Tier-3 Advancement!
Check out the stunning fighting techniques of the playful Super Hero!

 

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

New Artifacts have been added for Deadpool and Gwenpool.

* The effects are based on the 6★ Artifact passive skill LV.4 stats.

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes
​
1. The issue of the effects of the Exclusive Passive Skill Artifact of Hawkeye 
being displayed wrongly has been fixed.

 

Before: regardless of the Critical Rate
After: regardless of Guaranteed Critical Rate

 

We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held in celebration of the new Uniforms of Deadpool and Gwenpool.

 

Thank you.
